- [Systemic Lupus Erythematosus](https://astramd.org/articles/systemic-lupus-erythematosus): Manage SLE by confirming a clinical autoimmune phenotype, rapidly identifying renal, neurologic, hematologic, thrombotic, and cardiopulmonary threats, then using hydroxychloroquine and early steroid-sparing therapy to control activity while limiting glucocorticoid damage. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/systemic-lupus-erythematosus/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/systemic-lupus-erythematosus/article.json)
- [Aortic Stenosis](https://astramd.org/articles/aortic-stenosis): Aortic stenosis management hinges on confirming hemodynamic severity, resolving low-gradient discordance, and selecting valve replacement modality through anatomy, operative risk, life expectancy, concomitant disease, and transfemoral access. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/aortic-stenosis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/aortic-stenosis/article.json)
- [Hyperthyroidism](https://astramd.org/articles/hyperthyroidism): Confirm biochemical thyrotoxicosis, rapidly identify thyroid storm, then distinguish hormone overproduction from destructive or exogenous hormone exposure to select thionamides, definitive therapy, or non-antithyroid management. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hyperthyroidism/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hyperthyroidism/article.json)
- [Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/gastroesophageal-reflux-disease): Manage GERD by separating unproven reflux from proven reflux with persistent symptoms, selecting ambulatory testing on or off proton pump inhibitors accordingly, and reserving invasive therapy for objectively documented reflux with an appropriate anatomic and physiologic phenotype. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/gastroesophageal-reflux-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/gastroesophageal-reflux-disease/article.json)
- [Burkitt Lymphoma](https://astramd.org/articles/burkitt-lymphoma): Burkitt lymphoma requires urgent expert confirmation, staging that specifically interrogates marrow and cerebrospinal fluid, tumor-lysis planning, and prompt rituximab-containing multiagent therapy with central nervous system-directed treatment selected by disease risk and CNS involvement. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/burkitt-lymphoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/burkitt-lymphoma/article.json)
- [Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma](https://astramd.org/articles/diffuse-large-b-cell-lymphoma): Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma requires prompt tissue-confirmed classification, molecular risk assessment, stage-directed curative-intent therapy, and early referral for cellular therapy when relapse occurs within 12 months or disease is refractory. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/diffuse-large-b-cell-lymphoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/diffuse-large-b-cell-lymphoma/article.json)
- [Follicular Lymphoma](https://astramd.org/articles/follicular-lymphoma): Manage follicular lymphoma by confirming grade and excluding transformation, staging with FDG PET/CT, reserving therapy for clinically consequential disease, and tailoring relapse treatment to timing, prior exposure, refractoriness, fitness, and planned cellular or T-cell–engaging therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/follicular-lymphoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/follicular-lymphoma/article.json)
- [Hairy Cell Leukemia](https://astramd.org/articles/hairy-cell-leukemia): Confirm classic HCL with integrated morphology, immunophenotyping, and BRAF V600E assessment; treat only clinically consequential disease, then select purine analog, BRAF-directed therapy, or relapse-directed treatment by infection status, fitness, and remission duration. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hairy-cell-leukemia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hairy-cell-leukemia/article.json)
- [Hodgkin Lymphoma](https://astramd.org/articles/hodgkin-lymphoma): Confirm Hodgkin lymphoma on adequately sampled tissue, stage with FDG-PET/CT, and use disease extent, bulk, prognosis, and PET-adapted response to select curative-intent treatment while minimizing late toxicity. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hodgkin-lymphoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hodgkin-lymphoma/article.json)
- [Mantle Cell Lymphoma](https://astramd.org/articles/mantle-cell-lymphoma): Confirm mantle cell lymphoma with tissue-based cyclin D1/CCND1 testing, distinguish its key diagnostic mimics, stage before treatment, and select induction intensity by fitness. Relapse management depends critically on prior BTK inhibitor exposure and eligibility for cellular therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/mantle-cell-lymphoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/mantle-cell-lymphoma/article.json)
- [Multiple Myeloma](https://astramd.org/articles/multiple-myeloma): Multiple myeloma management requires confirmation of a myeloma-defining event, urgent control of organ-threatening complications, risk-informed induction and transplant planning, and sequencing of cellular or T-cell–redirecting therapies at relapse. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/multiple-myeloma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/multiple-myeloma/article.json)
- [Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma](https://astramd.org/articles/non-hodgkin-lymphoma): Non-Hodgkin lymphoma requires rapid conversion of a suspected lymphoid malignancy into a specific histologic diagnosis, stage, and tempo category. Management diverges sharply between aggressive entities requiring prompt systemic therapy and indolent entities in which symptom burden and disease distribution determine treatment timing. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/non-hodgkin-lymphoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/non-hodgkin-lymphoma/article.json)
- [Cellulitis](https://astramd.org/articles/cellulitis): Manage presumed cellulitis by first excluding a drainable abscess and necrotizing infection, then matching antibiotics to purulence, systemic severity, and MRSA risk. Most uncomplicated nonpurulent cases require streptococcal coverage, source-control assessment, and reassessment within 48 hours. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/cellulitis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/cellulitis/article.json)
- [Osteomyelitis](https://astramd.org/articles/osteomyelitis): Osteomyelitis management depends on anatomic syndrome, microbiologic confirmation, source control, and a feasible antimicrobial route. In diabetic foot disease, probe-to-bone, radiography, MRI, and bone biopsy guide diagnosis; selected patients can receive medical therapy or conservative bone resection. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/osteomyelitis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/osteomyelitis/article.json)
- [Myasthenia Gravis](https://astramd.org/articles/myasthenia-gravis): Myasthenia gravis requires rapid separation of respiratory or bulbar deterioration from stable ocular or generalized disease, confirmation with antibody and electrodiagnostic testing, chest imaging for thymoma, and phenotype-directed escalation from pyridostigmine to immunotherapy or rescue treatment. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/myasthenia-gravis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/myasthenia-gravis/article.json)
- [Orbital Cellulitis](https://astramd.org/articles/orbital-cellulitis): Orbital cellulitis requires immediate distinction from preseptal infection because pain with eye movement, ophthalmoplegia, proptosis, or visual impairment signals postseptal disease, urgent contrast imaging, hospital-based intravenous therapy, and ophthalmology-ENT coordination to prevent vision-threatening or intracranial extension. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/orbital-cellulitis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/orbital-cellulitis/article.json)
- [Pediatric Asthma](https://astramd.org/articles/pediatric-asthma): Confirm variable airflow limitation when feasible, treat exacerbations promptly with bronchodilation and early corticosteroids, and adjust long-term therapy according to current control, exacerbation risk, adherence, inhaler technique, and age-specific treatment options. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/pediatric-asthma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/pediatric-asthma/article.json)
- [Perioperative Management of Congenital Heart Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/perioperative-management-of-congenital-heart-disease): Noncardiac surgery in patients with congenital heart disease requires lesion- and physiology-specific planning. Determine residual obstruction, shunt direction, ventricular function, pulmonary vascular disease, rhythm risk, and procedural stress before selecting surgical setting, monitoring, anesthesia, and postoperative disposition. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/perioperative-management-of-congenital-heart-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/perioperative-management-of-congenital-heart-disease/article.json)
- [Anion Gap Metabolic Acidosis](https://astramd.org/articles/anion-gap-metabolic-acidosis): Use blood gas confirmation, anion-gap classification, potassium, kidney function, and urinary ammonium surrogates to rapidly distinguish life-threatening organic acid accumulation from gastrointestinal bicarbonate loss, renal tubular acidosis, chronic kidney disease, and chloride-related acidosis. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/anion-gap-metabolic-acidosis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/anion-gap-metabolic-acidosis/article.json)
- [Low Back Pain](https://astramd.org/articles/low-back-pain): A decision-focused approach to low back pain that prioritizes cauda equina syndrome, spinal infection, fracture, malignancy, and progressive neurologic deficit; limits low-value imaging; and selects function-oriented nonpharmacologic, medication, injection, or surgical pathways. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/low-back-pain/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/low-back-pain/article.json)
- [Patient Communication in Substance Use Disorders](https://astramd.org/articles/patient-communication-in-substance-use-disorders): Use nonjudgmental, person-centered communication to identify treatment goals, address ambivalence, reduce stigma, and connect patients with substance use disorders to evidence-based medications, behavioral treatment, harm reduction, and longitudinal follow-up. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/patient-communication-in-substance-use-disorders/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/patient-communication-in-substance-use-disorders/article.json)
- [Mitral Regurgitation](https://astramd.org/articles/mitral-regurgitation): A decision-focused approach to confirming severity, separating primary from secondary mitral regurgitation, selecting repair versus transcatheter therapy, and identifying patients whose ventricular remodeling or heart failure burden warrants multidisciplinary valve intervention. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/mitral-regurgitation/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/mitral-regurgitation/article.json)
- [Cushing Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/cushing-disease): Confirm persistent endogenous hypercortisolism before localization, then distinguish pituitary ACTH secretion from ectopic ACTH production with pituitary MRI and selective inferior petrosal sinus sampling. Transsphenoidal resection is first-line; recurrent or persistent disease requires individualized multimodal cortisol control. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/cushing-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/cushing-disease/article.json)
- [Cushing Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/cushing-syndrome): Confirm autonomous hypercortisolism before localization, then use ACTH to separate adrenal from pituitary or ectopic disease. Surgical cure is preferred, but urgent cortisol control, source-directed imaging, petrosal sampling, and medical bridging are essential when disease is severe or surgery is not curative. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/cushing-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/cushing-syndrome/article.json)
- [Hypothyroidism](https://astramd.org/articles/hypothyroidism): Use TSH and free T4 to distinguish primary from central hypothyroidism, identify myxedema coma immediately, individualize levothyroxine initiation for cardiovascular risk, and avoid routine treatment of mild persistent subclinical disease in older adults. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hypothyroidism/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hypothyroidism/article.json)
- [Pituitary Hyperplasia in Primary Hypothyroidism](https://astramd.org/articles/pituitary-hyperplasia-in-primary-hypothyroidism): In a patient with pituitary enlargement, markedly elevated TSH with low free thyroxine should redirect management toward primary hypothyroidism. Recognize diffuse thyrotroph hyperplasia, assess mass effect and pituitary axes, replace thyroid hormone, and document regression before considering pituitary surgery. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/pituitary-hyperplasia-in-primary-hypothyroidism/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/pituitary-hyperplasia-in-primary-hypothyroidism/article.json)
- [Bacterial Pneumonia](https://astramd.org/articles/bacterial-pneumonia): Manage suspected bacterial pneumonia by establishing illness severity and site of care, confirming a compatible pulmonary process, obtaining targeted microbiology in severe disease, and rapidly reconsidering alternative diagnoses or complications when empiric therapy fails. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/bacterial-pneumonia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/bacterial-pneumonia/article.json)
- [COVID-19 Vaccine](https://astramd.org/articles/covid-19-vaccine): Use the current-season COVID-19 vaccine to restore protection against circulating SARS-CoV-2, then prioritize a second dose for adults 65 years or older and people with moderate or severe immunocompromise at 6 months, with individualized additional dosing for immunocompromised patients. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/covid-19-vaccine/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/covid-19-vaccine/article.json)
- [Absence Seizure](https://astramd.org/articles/absence-seizure): Confirm typical absence seizures with an event-capturing EEG, then classify childhood versus juvenile absence epilepsy and screen for myoclonic or generalized tonic-clonic seizures before selecting ethosuximide, valproate, or lamotrigine. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/absence-seizure/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/absence-seizure/article.json)
- [Brainstem Stroke](https://astramd.org/articles/brainstem-stroke): Brainstem stroke requires immediate vascular imaging and reperfusion assessment because minor-appearing cranial nerve, gait, or consciousness findings may represent basilar occlusion, vertebral dissection, or perforator infarction with rapid respiratory, motor, and consciousness deterioration. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/brainstem-stroke/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/brainstem-stroke/article.json)
- [Generalized Tonic-Clonic Seizure](https://astramd.org/articles/generalized-tonic-clonic-seizure): Manage an ongoing convulsion as status epilepticus at 5 minutes while establishing airway protection and reversible causes. After stabilization, distinguish generalized-onset epilepsy from focal-to-bilateral tonic-clonic seizure, acute symptomatic seizure, convulsive syncope, and eclampsia to guide EEG, imaging, recurrence counseling, and antiseizure therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/generalized-tonic-clonic-seizure/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/generalized-tonic-clonic-seizure/article.json)
- [Lacunar Stroke](https://astramd.org/articles/lacunar-stroke): Manage suspected lacunar stroke as an acute ischemic stroke while confirming the mechanism with diffusion MRI and vascular-cardioembolic evaluation. Long-term decisions hinge on distinguishing true small-vessel disease from parent-artery, embolic, or incidental infarction and avoiding harmful chronic dual antiplatelet therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/lacunar-stroke/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/lacunar-stroke/article.json)
- [Multiple Sclerosis](https://astramd.org/articles/multiple-sclerosis): Diagnose multiple sclerosis by demonstrating typical dissemination and excluding mimics, treat clinically meaningful relapses promptly, and initiate disease-modifying therapy early while matching efficacy, safety, reproductive plans, and inflammatory activity. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/multiple-sclerosis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/multiple-sclerosis/article.json)
- [Seizure](https://astramd.org/articles/seizure): Manage a suspected seizure by identifying ongoing status epilepticus, rapidly separating acute provoked from unprovoked events, obtaining targeted metabolic, infectious, toxicologic, EEG, and neuroimaging data, and using recurrence-risk features to decide whether long-term antiseizure treatment is justified. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/seizure/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/seizure/article.json)
- [Stroke Mimics](https://astramd.org/articles/stroke-mimics): Acute focal deficits require parallel stroke treatment readiness and rapid mimic recognition. Use bedside pattern analysis, glucose testing, CT-based vascular imaging, and selectively MRI or EEG to identify seizure, migraine, metabolic, functional, vestibular, inflammatory, venous, and structural alternatives without delaying reperfusion decisions. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/stroke-mimics/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/stroke-mimics/article.json)
- [Abnormal Uterine Bleeding](https://astramd.org/articles/abnormal-uterine-bleeding): Evaluate abnormal uterine bleeding by first excluding pregnancy and nonuterine bleeding, then stratifying endometrial cancer risk, identifying PALM-COEIN causes, and selecting imaging, sampling, medical therapy, or uterine intervention according to bleeding pattern and reproductive goals. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/abnormal-uterine-bleeding/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/abnormal-uterine-bleeding/article.json)
- [Congenital Hypothyroidism](https://astramd.org/articles/congenital-hypothyroidism): Manage an abnormal newborn screen as a time-critical thyroid hormone deficiency: confirm with serum testing, begin levothyroxine promptly, monitor free T4 and TSH intensively, and use thyroid imaging to clarify permanence without delaying treatment. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/congenital-hypothyroidism/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/congenital-hypothyroidism/article.json)
- [Generalized Anxiety Disorder](https://astramd.org/articles/generalized-anxiety-disorder): Diagnose generalized anxiety disorder clinically after defining severity, functional impairment, comorbidity, substance contributions, and acute safety risk; then match treatment intensity to patient preference, access, and prior response using cognitive behavioral therapy, an SSRI, or an SNRI. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/generalized-anxiety-disorder/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/generalized-anxiety-disorder/article.json)
- [Aspiration Pneumonia](https://astramd.org/articles/aspiration-pneumonia): Manage suspected aspiration pneumonia as community-acquired pneumonia unless resistant-pathogen risk is independently present, while distinguishing infection from aspiration pneumonitis, pulmonary edema, and obstructing or cavitary disease. Prioritize oxygenation, radiographic confirmation, targeted microbiology, swallowing evaluation, and prevention of recurrent aspiration. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/aspiration-pneumonia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/aspiration-pneumonia/article.json)
- [Community-Acquired Pneumonia](https://astramd.org/articles/community-acquired-pneumonia): A decision-focused approach to confirming community-acquired pneumonia, selecting site of care, identifying severe disease and resistant-pathogen risk, obtaining targeted microbiology, and reassessing response when initial therapy fails. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/community-acquired-pneumonia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/community-acquired-pneumonia/article.json)
- [Severe Acute Malnutrition](https://astramd.org/articles/severe-acute-malnutrition): Recognize severe acute malnutrition by anthropometry or nutritional edema, distinguish marasmus from kwashiorkor, triage complications requiring inpatient stabilization, and transition feeding deliberately to avoid metabolic and fluid-related deterioration. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/severe-acute-malnutrition/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/severe-acute-malnutrition/article.json)
- [Gastrointestinal Bleeding Scan](https://astramd.org/articles/gastrointestinal-bleeding-scan): Technetium-99m–labeled red blood cell scintigraphy can document active or intermittent gastrointestinal bleeding when endoscopy is nondiagnostic or impractical, but its limited anatomic precision means results should guide—not independently determine—angiography, endoscopy, or surgery. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/gastrointestinal-bleeding-scan/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/gastrointestinal-bleeding-scan/article.json)
- [Open-Angle Glaucoma](https://astramd.org/articles/open-angle-glaucoma): Manage open-angle glaucoma by confirming open-angle optic neuropathy, establishing a patient-specific pressure-reduction target, and selecting drops, selective laser trabeculoplasty, or surgery according to disease severity, baseline IOP, tolerance, adherence, and documented structural or functional progression. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/open-angle-glaucoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/open-angle-glaucoma/article.json)
- [Eosinophilic Pneumonia](https://astramd.org/articles/eosinophilic-pneumonia): Confirm pulmonary eosinophilia, triage hypoxemic acute disease, and identify an exposure, drug, infection, systemic disorder, or chronic idiopathic pattern before committing to corticosteroid treatment. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/eosinophilic-pneumonia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/eosinophilic-pneumonia/article.json)
- [Obesity-Hypoventilation Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/obesity-hypoventilation-syndrome): Confirm awake hypercapnia in an obese patient, exclude alternative causes of hypoventilation, identify coexisting sleep-disordered breathing, and use positive-airway-pressure therapy to prevent recurrent acute-on-chronic hypercapnic respiratory failure. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/obesity-hypoventilation-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/obesity-hypoventilation-syndrome/article.json)
- [Pneumocystis jirovecii Pneumonia](https://astramd.org/articles/pneumocystis-jirovecii-pneumonia): Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia requires rapid risk-based recognition, respiratory severity assessment, organism-directed testing, and early TMP-SMX. In HIV, hypoxemia determines adjunctive corticosteroid use; in non-HIV immunosuppression, diagnostic uncertainty and the corticosteroid benefit-risk balance require individualized decisions. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/pneumocystis-jirovecii-pneumonia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/pneumocystis-jirovecii-pneumonia/article.json)
- [Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia](https://astramd.org/articles/ventilator-associated-pneumonia): Ventilator-associated pneumonia requires prompt empiric treatment when clinical suspicion is high, while respiratory sampling, serial reassessment, and culture-directed de-escalation limit overtreatment in a syndrome with imperfect diagnostic tests. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/ventilator-associated-pneumonia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/ventilator-associated-pneumonia/article.json)
- [Gout](https://astramd.org/articles/gout): Manage gout by confirming or strongly supporting monosodium urate deposition, excluding septic arthritis in an acutely inflamed joint, selecting flare therapy by comorbidity, and using treat-to-target urate lowering with prophylaxis to dissolve deposits and prevent recurrent disease. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/gout/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/gout/article.json)
- [Rheumatoid Arthritis](https://astramd.org/articles/rheumatoid-arthritis): Rheumatoid arthritis management depends on prompt initiation of a conventional DMARD, predefined assessment against remission or low disease activity, and rapid treatment adjustment when the target is missed. Therapy selection must balance inflammatory control with methotrexate tolerance, prior DMARD response, infection risk, and cardiovascular risk factors. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/rheumatoid-arthritis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/rheumatoid-arthritis/article.json)
- [Sexually Transmitted Infections](https://astramd.org/articles/sexually-transmitted-infections): Use exposure-site testing, syndrome-directed empiric treatment when indicated, pregnancy-specific screening, partner management, and targeted prevention to interrupt transmission while preventing pelvic inflammatory disease, adverse pregnancy outcomes, and neonatal infection. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/sexually-transmitted-infections/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/sexually-transmitted-infections/article.json)
- [Nephrolithiasis](https://astramd.org/articles/nephrolithiasis): Manage suspected renal or ureteral calculi by first identifying infected obstruction, renal threat, or uncontrolled symptoms; use noncontrast CT to define actionable anatomy; then select observation, expulsive therapy, ureteroscopy, shock-wave lithotripsy, or recurrence prevention according to stone burden and clinical trajectory. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/nephrolithiasis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/nephrolithiasis/article.json)
- [Migraine Headache](https://astramd.org/articles/migraine-headache): Diagnose migraine clinically while screening for secondary headache and medication overuse; treat attacks early, select prevention by monthly migraine burden and comorbidity, and use parenteral evidence-based regimens for refractory emergency presentations. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/migraine-headache/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/migraine-headache/article.json)
- [Neonatal Jaundice](https://astramd.org/articles/neonatal-jaundice): Manage neonatal jaundice with age-specific bilirubin assessment, prompt identification of hemolysis and other high-risk patterns, guideline-based phototherapy, and urgent escalation for bilirubin encephalopathy or exchange-level hyperbilirubinemia. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/neonatal-jaundice/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/neonatal-jaundice/article.json)
- [Sleep Apnea Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/sleep-apnea-syndrome): Confirm suspected obstructive sleep apnea with polysomnography or appropriate home testing, stratify severity by respiratory-event burden, and match treatment to anatomy, positive-airway-pressure tolerance, and cardiometabolic risk. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/sleep-apnea-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/sleep-apnea-syndrome/article.json)
- [Postoperative Delirium](https://astramd.org/articles/postoperative-delirium): Postoperative delirium requires structured bedside detection, rapid identification of reversible physiologic and medication precipitants, safety-focused nonpharmacologic management, and selective escalation for severe agitation. Prevention begins before surgery by identifying cognitive vulnerability and implementing multicomponent perioperative care. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/postoperative-delirium/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/postoperative-delirium/article.json)
- [Essential Hypertension](https://astramd.org/articles/essential-hypertension): A practical approach to confirm sustained hypertension with out-of-office measurement, stratify treatment thresholds by cardiovascular risk, avoid white-coat misclassification, and systematically distinguish apparent from true resistant hypertension before intensifying therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/essential-hypertension/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/essential-hypertension/article.json)
- [Hypertension Clinical Trials](https://astramd.org/articles/hypertension-clinical-trials): Use hypertension trial evidence to select treatment thresholds and targets, verify uncontrolled blood pressure outside the office, intensify multidrug therapy appropriately, and reserve renal denervation for carefully selected patients after adherence, measurement, and secondary causes have been addressed. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hypertension-clinical-trials/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hypertension-clinical-trials/article.json)
- [Pulmonary Hypertension](https://astramd.org/articles/pulmonary-hypertension): Pulmonary hypertension requires invasive hemodynamic confirmation, separation of pre- from post-capillary physiology, and prompt identification of potentially curable chronic thromboembolic disease before PAH-targeted treatment is considered. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/pulmonary-hypertension/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/pulmonary-hypertension/article.json)
- [Acute-on-Chronic Liver Failure](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-on-chronic-liver-failure): Acute-on-chronic liver failure requires immediate identification of extrahepatic organ failure, reversal of precipitants, ICU-level organ support, and early transplant-center engagement. Serial assessment of organ dysfunction—not liver tests alone—determines prognosis, treatment intensity, and whether transplantation remains feasible. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-on-chronic-liver-failure/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-on-chronic-liver-failure/article.json)
- [Portal Hypertension](https://astramd.org/articles/portal-hypertension): Use portal-pressure thresholds and noninvasive risk stratification to identify clinically significant portal hypertension, prevent first decompensation, and select endoscopic or shunt-based therapy for bleeding and refractory ascites. - [Influenza](https://astramd.org/articles/influenza): A decision-focused approach to influenza testing, empiric antiviral treatment, agent selection, chemoprophylaxis, and outbreak control, emphasizing patients in whom treatment should not await confirmatory testing and those for whom testing changes management. - [Rapidly Progressive Glomerulonephritis](https://astramd.org/articles/rapidly-progressive-glomerulonephritis): Rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis requires urgent confirmation of glomerular injury, parallel serologic classification, kidney biopsy, and cause-specific therapy before potentially irreversible crescentic injury progresses to kidney failure or pulmonary hemorrhage. - [Cluster Headache](https://astramd.org/articles/cluster-headache): Recognize the cluster phenotype promptly, exclude a structural trigeminal autonomic cephalalgia mimic with neuroimaging, abort attacks with oxygen or a triptan, and rapidly add transitional and preventive therapy to suppress recurrent attacks during an active bout. - [Intracranial Hypertension](https://astramd.org/articles/intracranial-hypertension): Intracranial hypertension requires rapid separation of mass effect, hydrocephalus, hemorrhage, venous thrombosis, and idiopathic disease; management prioritizes herniation prevention, cerebral perfusion, etiologic imaging, and vision-preserving intervention when papilledema or progressive visual loss is present. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/intracranial-hypertension/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/intracranial-hypertension/article.json)
- [Medication-Overuse Headache](https://astramd.org/articles/medication-overuse-headache): Medication-overuse headache requires recognition of class-specific acute-medication thresholds, exclusion of alternative secondary headache causes, and a planned withdrawal strategy. Most patients stop nonopioid acute agents abruptly while migraine prevention and close follow-up address withdrawal symptoms, persistent migraine, and relapse risk. - [Tension-Type Headache](https://astramd.org/articles/tension-type-headache): Diagnose tension-type headache clinically after screening for secondary-headache red flags, distinguish episodic from chronic disease by monthly headache frequency, limit acute analgesic exposure, and reserve preventive strategies for chronic burden or recurrent treatment failure. - [Thunderclap Headache](https://astramd.org/articles/thunderclap-headache): Thunderclap headache requires urgent exclusion of subarachnoid hemorrhage and targeted evaluation for vascular, hemorrhagic, venous, pituitary, and pressure-related disorders. Recurrent attacks, triggers, examination, cerebrospinal fluid, and vascular imaging direct evaluation toward reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome or competing secondary causes. - [Pleural Effusion](https://astramd.org/articles/pleural-effusion): Evaluate pleural effusion by identifying instability or pleural infection, obtaining paired pleural-serum studies when sampling is indicated, and using fluid patterns to direct microbiology, cytology, biopsy, drainage, fibrinolysis, surgery, or durable symptom control. - [Acute Liver Failure](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-liver-failure): Acute liver failure requires immediate recognition of encephalopathy with INR greater than 1.5, etiologic triage, intensive monitoring for cerebral edema and multiorgan failure, early N-acetylcysteine when appropriate, and urgent coordination with a liver transplant center. - [Hepatitis B](https://astramd.org/articles/hepatitis-b): Use triple-panel serology to identify infection, immunity, and reactivation risk; stage confirmed chronic infection with HBV DNA, liver assessment, and fibrosis testing; then select durable antiviral suppression, pregnancy prevention measures, or surveillance based on cirrhosis and host risk. - [Hepatitis C](https://astramd.org/articles/hepatitis-c): Confirm viremia with HCV RNA, stage fibrosis without delaying therapy, identify cirrhosis and drug interactions, and treat nearly all nonpregnant patients with direct-acting antivirals. Cure is defined by undetectable HCV RNA 12 weeks after treatment completion. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hepatitis-c/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hepatitis-c/article.json)
- [Cataract](https://astramd.org/articles/cataract): Manage cataract by confirming that lens opacity—not corneal, retinal, optic nerve, or refractive disease—is the principal functional limitation; then align surgical timing, ocular risk stratification, intraocular lens selection, infection prevention, and follow-up with visual goals and comorbidity. - [Pediatric Pneumonia](https://astramd.org/articles/pediatric-pneumonia): Manage pediatric pneumonia by first identifying hypoxemia, respiratory distress, sepsis, and pleural complications; use selective imaging and microbiology; avoid biomarkers as stand-alone bacterial tests; and reassess nonresponse early for complications, resistant pathogens, or an alternative diagnosis. - [Polymyalgia Rheumatica](https://astramd.org/articles/polymyalgia-rheumatica): Manage suspected polymyalgia rheumatica by excluding concurrent giant cell arteritis and mimics before committing to prolonged glucocorticoids, then use individualized prednisone tapering with serial assessment of disease activity, inflammatory markers, and treatment toxicity. - [Weight Loss Plateau](https://astramd.org/articles/weight-loss-plateau): A weight-loss plateau usually reflects a new energy-balance equilibrium, adaptive reductions in expenditure, increased appetite, or relaxed adherence. - [Central Sleep Apnea](https://astramd.org/articles/central-sleep-apnea): Central sleep apnea requires phenotype confirmation and cause-directed management. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/central-sleep-apnea/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/central-sleep-apnea/article.json)
- [Obstructive Sleep Apnea](https://astramd.org/articles/obstructive-sleep-apnea): Diagnose suspected obstructive sleep apnea with appropriate sleep testing, prioritize symptom relief and blood-pressure control, and match PAP, mandibular advancement, weight management, positional therapy, or selected surgery to anatomy, severity, and treatment tolerance. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/obstructive-sleep-apnea/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/obstructive-sleep-apnea/article.json)
- [Acute Stress Disorder](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-stress-disorder): Diagnose acute stress disorder only after a qualifying trauma when clinically impairing symptoms persist 3 days to less than 1 month; exclude intoxication, medical causes, and competing psychiatric disorders, address safety, and reassess for PTSD after 1 month. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-stress-disorder/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-stress-disorder/article.json)
- [Transfusion-Related Acute Lung Injury](https://astramd.org/articles/transfusion-related-acute-lung-injury): TRALI is acute, noncardiogenic pulmonary edema beginning during or within 6 hours of transfusion. Immediate transfusion cessation, respiratory support, exclusion of circulatory overload, and transfusion-service reporting are the critical decisions; diuresis is not indicated unless concurrent TACO is present. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/transfusion-related-acute-lung-injury/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/transfusion-related-acute-lung-injury/article.json)
- [Stem Cell Transplantation in Sickle Cell Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/stem-cell-transplantation-in-sickle-cell-disease): Allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation can cure sickle cell disease, but donor availability, conditioning toxicity, graft failure, and graft-versus-host disease determine whether its risks outweigh progressive disease. Donor selection and post-transplant lineage-specific chimerism are central management decisions. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/stem-cell-transplantation-in-sickle-cell-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/stem-cell-transplantation-in-sickle-cell-disease/article.json)
- [Acute Mesenteric Ischemia](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-mesenteric-ischemia): Acute mesenteric ischemia requires immediate CT angiography, resuscitation, and coordinated vascular-surgical management. Etiology—arterial embolism, arterial thrombosis, nonocclusive hypoperfusion, venous thrombosis, or strangulation—determines revascularization, anticoagulation, laparotomy, and bowel-preservation strategy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-mesenteric-ischemia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-mesenteric-ischemia/article.json)
- [Prerenal Kidney Failure](https://astramd.org/articles/prerenal-kidney-failure): Prerenal kidney failure requires rapid separation of reversible renal hypoperfusion from acute tubular injury, obstruction, and congestive cardiorenal physiology. Use trajectory, volume assessment, urine studies, medication review, targeted fluid challenge, and serial creatinine and urine output to restore perfusion without causing harmful fluid accumulation. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/prerenal-kidney-failure/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/prerenal-kidney-failure/article.json)
- [Failure to Thrive](https://astramd.org/articles/failure-to-thrive): Failure to thrive is a growth pattern requiring confirmation on serial, correctly plotted measurements, structured feeding assessment, and targeted testing for medical, developmental, and social contributors. Most children can begin outpatient nutritional and behavioral intervention; acute illness, severe undernutrition, or tube-feeding need changes disposition. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/failure-to-thrive/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/failure-to-thrive/article.json)
- [Chronic Granulomatous Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/chronic-granulomatous-disease): Confirm suspected chronic granulomatous disease with neutrophil oxidative-burst testing, identify the genetic defect, aggressively investigate characteristic bacterial or fungal infections, control inflammatory complications without missing infection, and consider allogeneic hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation as potentially curative. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/chronic-granulomatous-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/chronic-granulomatous-disease/article.json)
- [Thermal Burns](https://astramd.org/articles/thermal-burns): Evaluate thermal burns by confirming airway risk, measuring partial- and full-thickness TBSA accurately, initiating response-titrated resuscitation for major injury, controlling pain, protecting wounds, and transferring patients whose size, depth, location, or inhalation risk requires burn-center care. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/thermal-burns/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/thermal-burns/article.json)
- [Ketamine in Pain Management](https://astramd.org/articles/ketamine-in-pain-management): Use subanesthetic ketamine selectively as an opioid-sparing analgesic for acute perioperative or severe acute pain, especially with opioid tolerance, while reserving chronic-pain infusions for carefully selected refractory cases with structured monitoring for dissociation, sympathetic effects, and longer-term toxicity. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/ketamine-in-pain-management/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/ketamine-in-pain-management/article.json)
- [Thyroid Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/thyroid-cancer): Management hinges on histology, anatomic extent, iodine avidity, and recurrence risk. Use ultrasound-directed staging and pathology to select lobectomy versus total thyroidectomy, reserve radioiodine for appropriate differentiated cancers, and avoid DTC algorithms in medullary disease. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/thyroid-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/thyroid-cancer/article.json)
- [Esophageal Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/esophageal-cancer): Esophageal cancer management hinges on histology, locoregional resectability, physiologic operability, and metastatic staging. Coordinate endoscopic diagnosis, staging, nutrition, and multidisciplinary selection of surgery-based, definitive chemoradiation, systemic, or symptom-directed treatment early. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/esophageal-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/esophageal-cancer/article.json)
- [Gastric Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/gastric-cancer): Stage gastric adenocarcinoma with cross-sectional imaging and selective laparoscopy, then direct care by resectability and tumor biology. Perioperative FLOT is central for localized advanced disease; metastatic treatment depends on HER2, MSI/MMR, PD-L1, and CLDN18.2 results. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/gastric-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/gastric-cancer/article.json)
- [Pancreatic Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/pancreatic-cancer): Manage pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma by establishing histology when systemic therapy is planned, defining vascular anatomy and metastatic burden on pancreas-protocol imaging, and selecting surgery-first versus neoadjuvant treatment through multidisciplinary review of resectability and biologic risk. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/pancreatic-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/pancreatic-cancer/article.json)
- [Acute Necrotizing Ulcerative Gingivitis](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-necrotizing-ulcerative-gingivitis): Acute necrotizing ulcerative gingivitis is a clinical diagnosis requiring prompt dental debridement, plaque-control measures, and assessment for immunosuppression or systemic illness. Distinguish papillary necrosis from herpetic, streptococcal, gonococcal, and immune-mediated gingival disease; escalate rapidly when necrosis extends or the host is severely immunocompromised. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-necrotizing-ulcerative-gingivitis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-necrotizing-ulcerative-gingivitis/article.json)
- [Basal Cell Carcinoma](https://astramd.org/articles/basal-cell-carcinoma): Manage basal cell carcinoma by confirming clinically uncertain lesions histologically, separating low-risk from high-risk or recurrent tumors, selecting margin-controlled surgery when tissue preservation and clearance matter, and escalating unresectable disease to Hedgehog inhibition or cemiplimab. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/basal-cell-carcinoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/basal-cell-carcinoma/article.json)
- [Bladder Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/bladder-cancer): Stage-directed bladder cancer management hinges on complete transurethral staging, separation of non-muscle-invasive from muscle-invasive disease, risk-adapted intravesical therapy, and timely cystectomy or chemoradiation when curative local treatment is indicated. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/bladder-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/bladder-cancer/article.json)
- [Cancer Screening](https://astramd.org/articles/cancer-screening): Select cancer screening by organ-specific eligibility, expected benefit, test performance, downstream diagnostic capacity, and patient ability to complete follow-up. Screening tests are not interchangeable: an abnormal stool, imaging, or biomarker result generally requires diagnostic evaluation rather than repeat screening. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/cancer-screening/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/cancer-screening/article.json)
- [Endometrial Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/endometrial-cancer): Endometrial cancer management hinges on diagnostic histology, extent of uterine and extrauterine disease, and molecular classification. Integrating MMR immunohistochemistry, POLE sequencing, and p53 testing refines hereditary-risk assessment, operative planning, prognosis, and systemic-treatment selection. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/endometrial-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/endometrial-cancer/article.json)
- [Hepatocellular Carcinoma](https://astramd.org/articles/hepatocellular-carcinoma): Manage hepatocellular carcinoma through risk-based surveillance, multiphasic imaging diagnosis in at-risk livers, integrated tumor and hepatic-reserve staging, and multidisciplinary selection among resection, transplantation, ablation, locoregional therapy, radiation, and systemic therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hepatocellular-carcinoma/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hepatocellular-carcinoma/article.json)
- [Testicular Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/testicular-cancer): Testicular germ cell tumors require prompt inguinal orchiectomy, serum-marker staging, and risk-adapted postorchiectomy management. Surveillance avoids overtreatment in many stage I patients, while cisplatin-based therapy cures most metastatic disease but requires durable toxicity-focused survivorship care. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/testicular-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/testicular-cancer/article.json)
- [Clostridioides difficile Infection](https://astramd.org/articles/clostridioides-difficile-infection): Diagnose clinically meaningful infection only in patients with new unexplained diarrhea, rapidly identify fulminant disease, select fidaxomicin or vancomycin by episode and severity, and prevent recurrence with risk-directed adjunctive and microbiota-based strategies. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/clostridioides-difficile-infection/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/clostridioides-difficile-infection/article.json)
- [Vulvar Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/vulvar-cancer): Manage vulvar cancer through biopsy-confirmed histology, clinically directed groin assessment, imaging for suspected nodal or advanced disease, and individualized primary excision with inguinofemoral staging. Sentinel-node techniques can reduce long-term morbidity in appropriately selected early-stage disease. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/vulvar-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/vulvar-cancer/article.json)
- [Laryngeal Cancer](https://astramd.org/articles/laryngeal-cancer): Manage laryngeal cancer by defining subsite, laryngeal function, local extent, nodal burden, and resectability before choosing single-modality treatment, larynx preservation, or total laryngectomy with planned rehabilitation. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/laryngeal-cancer/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/laryngeal-cancer/article.json)
- [Acute Myocarditis](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-myocarditis): Acute myocarditis requires rapid separation of uncomplicated inflammatory myocardial injury from acute coronary syndromes, fulminant shock, malignant arrhythmia, and biopsy-defined inflammatory syndromes requiring cause-directed immunosuppression or mechanical circulatory support. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-myocarditis/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-myocarditis/article.json)
- [Coronary Artery Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/coronary-artery-disease): Manage coronary artery disease by separating acute coronary syndrome from chronic coronary disease, selecting anatomy- or ischemia-directed testing for symptomatic patients, intensifying secondary prevention, and reserving revascularization for anatomically and clinically appropriate indications. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/coronary-artery-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/coronary-artery-disease/article.json)
- [Eisenmenger Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/eisenmenger-syndrome): Eisenmenger syndrome requires confirmation of fixed pulmonary vascular disease and shunt physiology, exclusion of reversible mimics, avoidance of destabilizing interventions, and individualized PAH-directed therapy in an adult congenital heart disease–pulmonary hypertension center. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/eisenmenger-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/eisenmenger-syndrome/article.json)
- [Inferior Vena Cava Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/inferior-vena-cava-syndrome): Inferior vena cava syndrome requires rapid distinction among acute iliocaval thrombosis, chronic obstruction, congenital anatomy, and malignant compression because anticoagulation, endovascular recanalization, oncologic treatment, and filter strategy differ substantially. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/inferior-vena-cava-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/inferior-vena-cava-syndrome/article.json)
- [Long QT Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/long-qt-syndrome): A practical framework for confirming congenital long QT syndrome, excluding acquired QT prolongation, identifying concealed disease, initiating genotype-informed arrhythmic risk reduction, and escalating to sympathetic denervation or defibrillator-based protection when breakthrough events persist. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/long-qt-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/long-qt-syndrome/article.json)
- [Rheumatic Heart Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/rheumatic-heart-disease): Rheumatic heart disease requires parallel prevention of recurrent acute rheumatic fever, lesion-specific valve surveillance, anticoagulation when indicated, and early referral for catheter-based or surgical intervention before irreversible pulmonary vascular or ventricular consequences develop. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/rheumatic-heart-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/rheumatic-heart-disease/article.json)
- [Sick Sinus Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/sick-sinus-syndrome): Diagnose sick sinus syndrome by documenting a temporal correlation between hypoperfusion symptoms and sinus-node dysfunction, after reversible causes are addressed. Permanent pacing is primarily a symptom-relief intervention for symptomatic bradycardia, chronotropic incompetence, or essential drug-related bradycardia. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/sick-sinus-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/sick-sinus-syndrome/article.json)
- [Subclavian Steal Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/subclavian-steal-syndrome): Evaluate suspected subclavian steal with bilateral arm pressures and vertebral-subclavian duplex, then define arch-vessel anatomy by CTA or MRA before revascularizing patients with posterior-circulation ischemia, disabling arm ischemia, coronary steal, or hemodialysis-access dysfunction. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/subclavian-steal-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/subclavian-steal-syndrome/article.json)
- [Superior Vena Cava Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/superior-vena-cava-syndrome): Superior vena cava syndrome requires rapid recognition of airway or cerebral compromise, contrast imaging to define obstruction, and etiologic triage between malignancy, device-associated thrombosis or stenosis, and less common mediastinal disorders. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/superior-vena-cava-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/superior-vena-cava-syndrome/article.json)
- [Androgen Insensitivity Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/androgen-insensitivity-syndrome): Diagnose androgen insensitivity syndrome by confirming a 46,XY DSD, excluding impaired testosterone synthesis, and identifying androgen receptor dysfunction. Management requires phenotype-specific counseling, coordinated DSD expertise, individualized gonadal decision-making, hormone planning, and lifelong attention to bone, sexual, reproductive, and psychosocial health. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/androgen-insensitivity-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/androgen-insensitivity-syndrome/article.json)
- [Carcinoid Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/carcinoid-syndrome): Carcinoid syndrome requires biochemical confirmation, staging of the underlying well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor, prompt control of hormone-mediated symptoms, and structured surveillance for carcinoid heart disease. Refractory diarrhea should trigger assessment of tumor burden, somatostatin analog delivery, and serotonin-directed or tumor-directed therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/carcinoid-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/carcinoid-syndrome/article.json)
- [Graves Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/graves-disease): Confirm Graves disease with TSH-receptor antibodies or characteristic diffuse uptake, distinguish it from destructive and nodular thyrotoxicosis, control adrenergic symptoms, then select antithyroid drugs, radioactive iodine, or thyroidectomy according to reproductive plans, orbitopathy, relapse risk, and treatment goals. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/graves-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/graves-disease/article.json)
- [Refeeding Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/refeeding-syndrome): Identify malnourished patients before carbohydrate delivery, obtain phosphate, potassium, magnesium, renal function, and glucose, give thiamine, initiate nutrition cautiously when risk is high, and respond promptly to falling electrolytes or cardiopulmonary dysfunction during the first days of refeeding. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/refeeding-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/refeeding-syndrome/article.json)
- [Budd-Chiari Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/budd-chiari-syndrome): Budd-Chiari syndrome requires urgent confirmation of hepatic venous outflow obstruction, immediate anticoagulation when feasible, systematic identification of thrombophilia or secondary obstruction, and rapid escalation to endovascular decompression, TIPS, or transplantation when hepatic dysfunction or portal-hypertension complications progress. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/budd-chiari-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/budd-chiari-syndrome/article.json)
- [Celiac Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/celiac-disease): Diagnose celiac disease while the patient is consuming gluten, using tTG-IgA plus total IgA first. In adults, confirm positive serology with properly sampled duodenal biopsies, then use a strict gluten-free diet, dietitian-led exposure review, and targeted reassessment for persistent symptoms or villous atrophy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/celiac-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/celiac-disease/article.json)
- [Irritable Bowel Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/irritable-bowel-syndrome): Use a positive symptom-based diagnosis, screen selectively for inflammatory, celiac, infectious, and structural mimics, then match therapy to bowel pattern and dominant symptom while reassessing alarm features or treatment-resistant change. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/irritable-bowel-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/irritable-bowel-syndrome/article.json)
- [Short Bowel Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/short-bowel-syndrome): Manage short bowel syndrome by defining residual anatomy and intestinal-failure severity, correcting high-output fluid and electrolyte losses, advancing enteral exposure, minimizing parenteral-support complications, and referring persistent dependence or adverse anatomy to an intestinal rehabilitation program. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/short-bowel-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/short-bowel-syndrome/article.json)
- [Wilson Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/wilson-disease): Diagnose Wilson disease by integrating copper studies, ophthalmologic and neurologic findings, and ATP7B testing when results are equivocal; then select lifelong chelation or zinc according to phenotype, hepatic severity, tolerance, and adherence risk. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/wilson-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/wilson-disease/article.json)
- [Febrile Neutropenia](https://astramd.org/articles/febrile-neutropenia): Febrile neutropenia is an oncologic emergency requiring immediate empiric antibacterial therapy, focused source evaluation, and disposition based on physiologic stability, anticipated neutropenia, and validated complication-risk assessment. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/febrile-neutropenia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/febrile-neutropenia/article.json)
- [Immune Thrombocytopenia](https://astramd.org/articles/immune-thrombocytopenia): Diagnose ITP only after confirming true isolated thrombocytopenia and excluding urgent thrombotic, marrow, infectious, drug-related, and pregnancy-specific causes. Management is driven by bleeding, platelet trajectory, treatment requirements, comorbidity, and durability goals rather than platelet count alone. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/immune-thrombocytopenia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/immune-thrombocytopenia/article.json)
- [Myelodysplastic Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/myelodysplastic-syndrome): Evaluate persistent unexplained cytopenias with marrow morphology, conventional cytogenetics, and molecular testing; then use IPSS-R or IPSS-M risk, transfusion burden, erythropoietin level, and transplant fitness to select supportive, anemia-directed, disease-modifying, or curative therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/myelodysplastic-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/myelodysplastic-syndrome/article.json)
- [Neutropenia](https://astramd.org/articles/neutropenia): Use absolute neutrophil count, trajectory, accompanying cytopenias, infection burden, and exposure history to distinguish transient acquired neutropenia from chronic immune, congenital, marrow, or treatment-related disease and to determine when marrow evaluation, G-CSF, or urgent infection management is warranted. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/neutropenia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/neutropenia/article.json)
- [Thrombocytopenia](https://astramd.org/articles/thrombocytopenia): A platelet count below 150 × 10^9/L requires rapid confirmation, bleeding and thrombosis triage, and pattern-based evaluation for pseudothrombocytopenia, consumption, microangiopathy, drug-mediated disease, immune destruction, or impaired production. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/thrombocytopenia/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/thrombocytopenia/article.json)
- [Von Willebrand Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/von-willebrand-disease): Diagnose von Willebrand disease by linking a clinically meaningful bleeding phenotype to repeatable VWF abnormalities, then select desmopressin, tranexamic acid, or VWF replacement according to subtype, procedural risk, and measured treatment response. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/von-willebrand-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/von-willebrand-disease/article.json)
- [Lyme Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/lyme-disease): Diagnose Lyme disease from syndrome-specific pretest probability, use validated two-tier serology when confirmation changes management, recognize carditis and neurologic emergencies, and select short, manifestation-directed antibiotic courses while avoiding unnecessary prolonged therapy. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/lyme-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/lyme-disease/article.json)
- [Ankle Fracture](https://astramd.org/articles/ankle-fracture): Assess neurovascular status and reduction urgency first, then determine mortise stability with appropriate radiographs and stress testing. Stable fractures can usually progress nonoperatively; talar shift, syndesmotic instability, or fracture-dislocation generally requires reduction and operative stabilization. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/ankle-fracture/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/ankle-fracture/article.json)
- [Cervical Degenerative Disc Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/cervical-degenerative-disc-disease): Manage cervical degenerative disc disease by separating axial pain, radiculopathy, and degenerative cervical myelopathy; obtain MRI when neural compression is suspected; and expedite spine referral for gait, hand-function, or progressive neurologic deficits. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/cervical-degenerative-disc-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/cervical-degenerative-disc-disease/article.json)
- [Clavicle Fracture](https://astramd.org/articles/clavicle-fracture): Management hinges on fracture location, displacement, stability, soft-tissue status, and associated neurovascular injury. Most minimally displaced fractures can be treated nonoperatively, whereas open injury, neurovascular compromise, unstable distal patterns, and selected completely displaced midshaft fractures warrant early fixation discussions. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/clavicle-fracture/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/clavicle-fracture/article.json)
- [Colles Fracture](https://astramd.org/articles/colles-fracture): Manage Colles fracture by identifying open, neurovascular, and unstable injuries; obtaining post-reduction alignment; then matching cast treatment or fixation to displacement, articular involvement, instability, functional demand, and the likelihood that loss of reduction would change management. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/colles-fracture/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/colles-fracture/article.json)
- [Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/legg-calve-perthes-disease): Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease requires early recognition of femoral-head ischemia, radiographic staging, and age- and severity-based containment decisions to preserve hip congruence. Management hinges on range of motion, lateral pillar involvement, extrusion, and timely pediatric orthopedic referral. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/legg-calve-perthes-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/legg-calve-perthes-disease/article.json)
- [Osgood-Schlatter Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/osgood-schlatter-disease): Diagnose Osgood-Schlatter disease clinically in adolescents with load-provoked tibial tubercle pain, while using radiographs selectively for unilateral, severe, persistent, or traumatic presentations that may indicate another proximal tibial lesion or avulsion injury. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/osgood-schlatter-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/osgood-schlatter-disease/article.json)
- [Pelvic Fracture](https://astramd.org/articles/pelvic-fracture): Pelvic fracture management hinges on early mechanical stabilization, rapid identification of competing bleeding sources, and pathway selection between laparotomy, preperitoneal packing, and angioembolization. Hemodynamic instability demands simultaneous damage-control resuscitation and definitive hemorrhage control at a trauma-capable center. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/pelvic-fracture/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/pelvic-fracture/article.json)
- [Alport Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/alport-syndrome): Confirm suspected Alport syndrome with COL4A3, COL4A4, and COL4A5 testing, define inheritance and renal risk, initiate renin-angiotensin system blockade when indicated, and identify relatives requiring surveillance before proteinuria and progressive kidney dysfunction develop. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/alport-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/alport-syndrome/article.json)
- [Cardiorenal Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/cardiorenal-syndrome): Cardiorenal syndrome requires phenotype-based management: distinguish congestion from hypoperfusion, establish whether cardiac, renal, or systemic disease is primary, and pursue decongestion without reflexively abandoning therapy for a creatinine rise. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/cardiorenal-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/cardiorenal-syndrome/article.json)
- [End-Stage Renal Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/end-stage-renal-disease): Manage kidney failure by identifying emergent dialysis indications, separating chronic uremic symptoms from reversible mimics, preparing renal replacement options before crisis, and initiating dialysis for refractory clinical complications rather than an isolated eGFR threshold. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/end-stage-renal-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/end-stage-renal-disease/article.json)
- [Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/hemolytic-uremic-syndrome): Hemolytic uremic syndrome is a thrombotic microangiopathy requiring immediate confirmation of hemolysis and kidney injury, exclusion of severe ADAMTS13 deficiency and Shiga toxin infection, identification of secondary triggers, and rapid complement-directed treatment when complement-mediated disease remains likely. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hemolytic-uremic-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hemolytic-uremic-syndrome/article.json)
- [Minimal Change Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/minimal-change-disease): Adult minimal change disease requires kidney-biopsy confirmation, exclusion of secondary drivers, prompt management of nephrotic complications, and a prolonged glucocorticoid course. Relapse pattern, steroid toxicity, and kidney function determine whether cyclophosphamide, calcineurin inhibition, or other steroid-sparing therapy is appropriate. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/minimal-change-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/minimal-change-disease/article.json)
- [Carpal Tunnel Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/carpal-tunnel-syndrome): Use a clinical pattern to identify typical mild carpal tunnel syndrome, reserve nerve conduction studies for diagnostic uncertainty or severe disease, initiate neutral-position night splinting, and refer promptly when weakness, thenar atrophy, or persistent symptoms warrant decompression. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/carpal-tunnel-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/carpal-tunnel-syndrome/article.json)
- [Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/charcot-marie-tooth-disease): Evaluate suspected Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease with phenotype, nerve conduction studies, and sequential genetic testing; distinguish uniform inherited demyelination from acquired neuropathy and pressure-palsy phenotypes, then initiate early rehabilitation, orthotic, orthopedic, genetic, and complication-directed care. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/charcot-marie-tooth-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/charcot-marie-tooth-disease/article.json)
- [Complex Regional Pain Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/complex-regional-pain-syndrome): Diagnose CRPS clinically with Budapest criteria while actively excluding focal nerve injury, infection, vascular disease, fracture complications, and inflammatory arthropathy. Prioritize early functional restoration; reserve medications, blocks, and neuromodulation for barriers to rehabilitation or persistent disabling pain. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/complex-regional-pain-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/complex-regional-pain-syndrome/article.json)
- [Huntington Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/huntington-disease): Confirm Huntington disease with targeted HTT CAG-repeat testing in the appropriate clinical context, distinguish phenocopies and secondary chorea, deliver structured predictive counseling, and target chorea, psychiatric disease, function, nutrition, and family planning through multidisciplinary care. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/huntington-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/huntington-disease/article.json)
- [Posterior Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/posterior-reversible-encephalopathy-syndrome): Recognize PRES as an acute clinicoradiologic syndrome requiring urgent MRI confirmation, blood-pressure and seizure control, and rapid reversal of hypertension, eclampsia, renal dysfunction, or drug-related endothelial injury. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/posterior-reversible-encephalopathy-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/posterior-reversible-encephalopathy-syndrome/article.json)
- [Restless Legs Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/restless-legs-syndrome): Restless legs syndrome is a clinical sensorimotor diagnosis requiring exclusion of mimics, identification of iron deficiency and medication triggers, and treatment proportional to symptom burden. Iron replacement and alpha-2-delta ligands generally reduce reliance on dopaminergic therapy and its augmentation risk. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/restless-legs-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/restless-legs-syndrome/article.json)
- [Genitourinary Syndrome of Menopause](https://astramd.org/articles/genitourinary-syndrome-of-menopause): A practical approach to confirming GSM, excluding competing vulvovaginal and urinary pathology, selecting local therapies, and individualizing treatment for patients with breast cancer or systemic hormone contraindications. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/genitourinary-syndrome-of-menopause/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/genitourinary-syndrome-of-menopause/article.json)
- [HELLP Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/hellp-syndrome): HELLP syndrome requires rapid confirmation of microangiopathic hemolysis, hepatic injury, and thrombocytopenia; stabilization of severe hypertension and seizure risk; exclusion of competing thrombotic microangiopathies and acute fatty liver; and delivery when maternal or fetal status warrants. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hellp-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hellp-syndrome/article.json)
- [Premenstrual Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/premenstrual-syndrome): Diagnose clinically significant premenstrual syndrome by documenting luteal-phase symptoms, functional impact, and a symptom-free follicular interval. Prospective daily ratings distinguish PMS from premenstrual exacerbation of psychiatric or medical disease and direct treatment toward behavioral strategies, SSRIs, or ovulation suppression. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/premenstrual-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/premenstrual-syndrome/article.json)
- [Down Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/down-syndrome): Clinical care in Down syndrome requires structured surveillance for congenital heart disease and evolving multisystem complications, plus a deliberate adult-life transition plan that recognizes the high risk of Alzheimer disease and changing care needs. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/down-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/down-syndrome/article.json)
- [Fetal Alcohol Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/fetal-alcohol-syndrome): Fetal alcohol syndrome is the severe phenotypic end of prenatal alcohol exposure, recognized by characteristic facial dysmorphology, growth impairment, and central nervous system dysfunction. Identification should trigger multidisciplinary neurodevelopmental assessment and needs-based intervention rather than reliance on facial findings alone. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/fetal-alcohol-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/fetal-alcohol-syndrome/article.json)
- [Fragile X Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/fragile-x-syndrome): Confirm suspected fragile X syndrome with dedicated FMR1 CGG-repeat and methylation testing, distinguish full mutation from premutation states, and use the result to direct developmental care, symptom-targeted treatment, and cascade reproductive counseling. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/fragile-x-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/fragile-x-syndrome/article.json)
- [Hirschsprung Disease](https://astramd.org/articles/hirschsprung-disease): Suspect Hirschsprung disease in neonatal distal bowel obstruction or refractory constipation with delayed meconium. Stabilize enterocolitis and obstruction first, establish aganglionosis by rectal pathology, define disease extent for pull-through planning, and systematically evaluate postoperative obstruction, soiling, and recurrent enterocolitis. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/hirschsprung-disease/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/hirschsprung-disease/article.json)
- [Klinefelter Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/klinefelter-syndrome): Confirm suspected Klinefelter syndrome with chromosome analysis, distinguish primary testicular failure from other hypogonadal states, address fertility before testosterone when relevant, and longitudinally manage hypogonadism alongside metabolic, bone, cardiovascular, reproductive, and psychosocial comorbidity. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/klinefelter-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/klinefelter-syndrome/article.json)
- [Sudden Infant Death Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/sudden-infant-death-syndrome): SIDS is a postmortem diagnosis of exclusion. Prevention hinges on repeated counseling for a supine, uncluttered infant sleep environment, while every sudden unexpected infant death requires coordinated history review, scene investigation, complete autopsy, and ancillary testing to distinguish unexplained death from suffocation, disease, trauma, or neglect. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/sudden-infant-death-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/sudden-infant-death-syndrome/article.json)
- [Turner Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/turner-syndrome): Confirm suspected Turner syndrome with appropriately extensive cytogenetic analysis, define mosaicism and Y-chromosome material, then initiate phenotype-directed cardiovascular, renal, endocrine, growth, reproductive, hearing, and neurodevelopmental surveillance across the lifespan. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/turner-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/turner-syndrome/article.json)
- [Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/neuroleptic-malignant-syndrome): Treat suspected neuroleptic malignant syndrome as a medical emergency: stop dopamine-blocking drugs, stabilize hyperthermia and rhabdomyolysis, exclude mimics, and escalate to intensive care when autonomic, respiratory, renal, or consciousness abnormalities are present. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/neuroleptic-malignant-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/neuroleptic-malignant-syndrome/article.json)
- [Secondary Hypertension](https://astramd.org/articles/secondary-hypertension): Identify secondary hypertension when presentation, treatment resistance, or target-organ injury suggests a remediable cause; confirm true resistance, remove iatrogenic contributors, then prioritize renal disease, primary aldosteronism, obstructive sleep apnea, renovascular disease, and selected endocrine disorders. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/secondary-hypertension/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/secondary-hypertension/article.json)
- [Osteoporosis in Females](https://astramd.org/articles/osteoporosis-in-females): A fracture-focused approach to osteoporosis in postmenopausal females: establish treatment eligibility from fragility fracture, DXA, and FRAX; exclude remediable secondary causes; select antiresorptive or bone-forming therapy by fracture risk; and prevent treatment gaps that accelerate bone loss. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/osteoporosis-in-females/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/osteoporosis-in-females/article.json)
- [Acute Chest Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-chest-syndrome): Acute chest syndrome requires immediate imaging, oxygenation assessment, empiric treatment for pulmonary infection, lung-expansion measures, and early transfusion escalation when hypoxemia or radiographic disease progresses. [Markdown](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-chest-syndrome/article.md) · [JSON](https://astramd.org/articles/acute-chest-syndrome/article.json)
- [Metabolic Syndrome](https://astramd.org/articles/metabolic-syndrome): Identify metabolic syndrome with a five-component screen, then treat the cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic risk profile rather than the label.
